title: Geonet's regions: res/geonet/regions.json
description: Members 0 to 17 of ARCID_GEONET_PLACE (a/0/5/2): where each region of the countries with regions is on the globe, a member for each country by its placeDataId in sSubdividedCountries (country_region.c), which Geonet_LoadPlaces reads. tools/data/geonet_place_data.py packs them.

country.description: The country's name in res/geonet/countries.json, which sSubdividedCountries gives this member; the packer checks it

regions.description: The country's regions, a GeonetRegionPlace each by the region's number; the first isn't a place

name.description: The region's name, its message of the country's text bank in sSubdividedCountries by ID, in the same order, or null past its last; the packer checks it and doesn't pack it

x.description: The globe's turn about its X axis that brings the region to the front (Geonet_AddPlace), in 65536ths of a turn

y.description: The globe's turn about its Y axis, in 65536ths of a turn
